name: grid-field
title: Grid Field
description: Graph-paper lines (or a dot grid) behind a section, with a few cells that slowly light up and fade, like squares being filled in on a worksheet. It says "careful, measured work" without saying anything.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/grid-field

Installed to `components/ui/effects/grid-field.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/grid-field';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/grid-field

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
